create_observer_quantization: create an Observer instance with quantization args to compute scales and zero points for tensor quantization
calculate_qparams_forward: call observer forward with observed tensor to compute calibrated scale and zero point
compute_global_scale: compute global scale from observed tensor for tensor-group quantization strategy
synchronize_ddp_observer: synchronize accumulated min-max statistics across DDP ranks using observer all-reduce
recompute_qparams_synchronize: recompute scale and zero point from globally reduced min-max statistics after DDP synchronization
